summary: Tested the split Pulse invoice header (logo flush-left with the content edge, address block flush-right) across the PDF generators, and the rebuilt fire-station certificates. Checked positions with PyMuPDF and looked at the rendered pages. pulse_header flowable: logo x0 = frame content left and address x1 = frame content right (the 6pt frame padding is included), no overlap, centres line up vertically, old 1800x215 header strip no longer used. Raw-canvas draw_invoice_header returns the correct bottom y. BFPO job sheet: logo at 18mm, address at page width minus 18mm. Live service-report.pdf API: split header present and no body text overlaps it. All 3 stored certificates: rebrand_tag pulse-split-header-2026-06, status kept (2 sent, 1 awaiting_review), 1 page each, logo at x=42 and address right edge at 553, no crest/header overlap, body below the header, 'Qualified to deliver the best' removed. CRM /api/crm/v2/certificates/{id}/download serves the split-header PDF. A fresh build with 2 treadmills is still 1 page. Visually the certificate and service report look clean and balanced. New brand PNGs are served from /brand/ with HTTP 200 and the bytes match the backend assets.
